defs.def: to become impossible to see 消失；不见

ex.s: A few years later, still attracted to the country, he returned to Uzbekistan to write an article about the disappearance of the Aral Sea.
ex.t: 几年后，他依然为这个国家着迷，便重返乌兹别克斯坦，写一篇关于咸海消失的文章。

ex.s: 58   you climb into an arctic-like zone with   59   snow and the glaciers that may soon disappear.
ex.t: 58  你爬进一个像北极一样的区域，那里有____雪和可能很快消失的冰川。

ex.s: Especially glbalisation and better communications in the past few decades, all have caused many Languages to disappear, and dominant languages such as English.
ex.t: 尤其是近几十年的全球化和更好的通讯方式，都导致许多语言消失，而英语等主导语言正在日益占据主导地位。

ex.s: By the 1920s, wolves had practically disappeared from the Yellowstone area.
ex.t: 到20世纪20年代，灰狼实际上已从黄石地区消失。

ex.s: The disappearance of the wolves had many unexpected results.
ex.t: 灰狼的消失带来了许多意想不到的结果。

ex.s: What did the disappearance of gray wolves bring about？
ex.t: 灰狼的消失带来了什么后果？

ex.s: When plants disappear, their scents become more difficult to produce.
ex.t: 当植物消失时，它们散发的气味变得更难产生。

ex.s: Disappearance of the Earth’s smells can be a cultural loss.
ex.t: 地球气味的消失可能是一种文化上的损失。

ex.s: The doubt about cloud seeding has disappeared.
ex.t: 对人工降雨的怀疑已经消失了。

ex.s: You might think these lakes would be expanding, not disappearing.
ex.t: 你可能会认为这些湖泊会扩大，而不是消失。

ex.s: But now it looks as if Arctic lakes are disappearing a century sooner than predicted.
ex.t: 但现在看来，北极湖泊消失的时间比预测的要早一个世纪。

ex.s: many Arctic lakes to grow largerD. the disappearance of many Arctic lakes
ex.t: 许多北极湖泊会变大 D. 许多北极湖泊的消失

ex.s: As the song goes, this long and winding road "will never disappear", and it will always stick in the visitor's memory.
ex.t: 正如歌中所唱，这条漫长而蜿蜒的道路“永远不会消失”，它将永远留在游客的记忆中。

ex.s: Once the drink is gone, the straw will take centuries to disappear.
ex.t: 一旦饮料喝完，吸管要花几个世纪才能降解消失。

ex.s: After becoming an important part of many British streets, the phone boxes began disappearing in the 1980s, with the rise of the mobile phone sending most of them away to the junkyards.
ex.t: 在成为许多英国街道的重要组成部分后，电话亭从20世纪80年代开始逐渐消失，随着手机的兴起，大多数被送进了垃圾场。

ex.s: It crashed through a wooden fence and disappeared.
ex.t: 它撞穿一道木栅栏后消失了。

ex.s: Reserve your spot before availability — the cherry blossoms — disappear!
ex.t: 华盛顿特区樱花自行车之旅

ex.s: It will disappear gradually.
ex.t: 尽量在潮湿的区域挖洞以提高集水器的效率。

ex.s: It will disappear with the development of AI.
ex.t: 随着人工智能的发展，它将消失。

ex.s: By the end of the run, all my stress has disappeared and I'm ready to face the next day at work.
ex.t: 跑到终点时，我所有的压力都消失了，我已准备好面对第二天的工作。

ex.s: She surfaces, cries in fear, then disappears forever.
ex.t: 她浮出水面，恐惧地哭喊，然后永远消失了。

ex.s: For the most part, he did not mention the children he saved, and his actions soon disappeared from people's memories.
ex.t: 在大多数情况下，他没有提过他所拯救的那些孩子，他的行为也很快从人们的记忆中消失了。

ex.s: It will vanish, pass into future time, and disappear.
ex.t: 它将消失，进入未来的时间，然后消失不见。

ex.s: Beyond that the colours darkened into fine shades of deep blue, and gradually disappeared.
ex.t: 再往远处，颜色逐渐变深，呈现出深蓝色的细腻渐变，然后渐渐消失了。

defs.def: to stop existing 不复存在；灭绝；消亡

ex.s: The disappearance of dinosaurs is not necessarily caused by astronomical incidents.
ex.t: 恐龙的消失不一定是由天文事件引起的。

defs.def: to be lost or impossible to find 失踪；丢失
